implementation_blockers: HpConfigure caches at most3 records per loaded area, not3 simultaneous near-camera records. An area with>3 proposed/new helpers needs an explicitly reviewed streaming/reuse design; do not merely append records that will never admit.

Raw0 has no H/V helper mask; MarioVariant4 needs exact variant admission. A tier-dependent eligibility also needs real identity-cache/lifecycle review; no helper must disappear from under a supported player on pickup.

Static columns omit real enemy-based moving platforms/springs/transport execution and castle-maze state. Lists are complete enumerations of the declared geometric candidate classes, not a proved minimal set of mandatory obstructions.

Horizontal and vertical sine support/carry must remain actual native actors25/28; proposed centers are source geometry plans, not qualified placement bytes. Actor budgets, loadedscene key and absent-slot behavior need controls.
ExistingXML alignment is historical and differs from native columns at several landmarks; output x is actual native parser x, not blindly importedXML.
HostCels tier0 has no grip; tier1walljump nativePASS does not prove tier0campaign. No jump/physics unlock or painted terrain authorized.
